answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 9830 Country: Pakistan Title: Can We Record Adan in Mobile and When New Baby is Born We Play Adan from the Mobile Phone and Keep it close to the ear of new born baby because my voice is not too loud and clear. Question: Can We Record Adan in Mobile and When New Baby is Born We Play Adan from the Mobile Phone and Keep it close to the ear of new born baby because my voice is not too loud and clear. Answer ID: 9830 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2401/2156=D/1429) Recording azan in mobile and listening is permissible, but the sunnah will not be performed by playing it for the baby. If a mobile contains obscene materials and music then keeping azan is also not right, it is against the respect of azan. Keeping azan as ring tone is also makrooh (undesirable). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
